--- Page 1 ---
September 8, 1982

AIC
SSE.
CinWich

To: Mr. G. H. Long

From: T. E. Miller

Re: COMPETITIVE ACTIVITIES

American Tobacco

- Lucky Strike Filter and Rox styles are being expanded to portions of New York, New Jersey, Illinois, and Indiana. First shipments start September 20, 1982. Information was sent to us by Mr. N. J. Papapietro, Brooklyn DM, and Mr. George Moulton, Manhattan DM.

- ATC Shelf Display Program - Mr. Don Crees, Tulsa DM, sent us the attached contract outlining ATC's current shelf display program.

Brown & Williamson

- B&W announced a cutback of its third shift at the Petersburg, Virginia, branch. Attached is a letter B&W sent to a community college in an apparent attempt to get some of their people placed. This information was sent to us by Mr. Cecyl Waldrop, Roanoke DM.

Lorillard

- Satin - Lorillard introduced Satin 100mm Regular and Menthol styles in Denver and Milwaukee on June 3, 1982. Ms. Jean Lampert, N. Denver DM, sent us the attached promotion offering smokers a free Satin pouch by calling a toll free number.

Liggett & Myers

- Generics - Mr. Cecyl Waldrop, Roanoke DM, informed us that Revco would start stocking their own generic cigarette in kings, menthol kings, and 100's styles made by Liggett.

- Generic Ultra Lights - Effective August 2, Liggett started shipping to jobbers Generic Ultra Lights 85's and 100's. Attached is the introductory brochure sent to us by Mr. David Hobbs, Richmond DM.

50189 1308
